summary: Both round-1 findings resolved. Trigger drag-stop test (line 719) uses nodeId 'trigger:1', asserts body.triggers[1].canvasPosition === {x:80,y:160}, confirms sibling triggers[0].canvasPosition is null, and verifies triggerType/triggerValue survive sanitizeTrigger — load-bearing because without canvasPosition in sanitizeTrigger the equality would fail. Read-only list test (line 806) now drains the on-mount autosave past the 600ms debounce, clears the mock, triggers row select, waits another 700ms, and asserts storeMock.update not called — behavioral silence is demonstrated, not just DOM absence. All assertions are value-based. No coverage lost.
